plan.summary: Downstate first Broadway preview was postponed again for illness; Playbill now reports the first preview as October 22, 2026 (opening still November 15).

actions.description: Playbill (https://playbill.com/article/downstate-delays-first-broadway-preview): preview pushed from Oct 17 to Oct 19, then Oct 20, now first performance October 22 at the Booth Theatre; opening night still Nov 15. The audit's Oct 20 cluster date was superseded by that update.
